Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted Danish place-name spellings, incorrectly equating Aarhus/Århus with Aalborg/Ålborg under “Aa” normalization. Despite sources clearly listing Århus/Aarhus as Anne Gadegaard’s birthplace, the Planner concluded it corresponded to Aalborg, leading toward a wrong birthplace.
